plan.authorization: 2026-11-02 user authorized staged recovery plan, contingent on P1 failing Minecart gate and implementation qualification
plan.purpose: Prospective 2x2 factorial of uniform preference relabeling and utility-aligned auxiliary loss; all source and task gates retained
plan.allocation: Uniform same protocol pool, fixed behavior preference/head per episode in every arm. Relabel arms independently draw ONE pool weight per replay row for both Q input and DDQN target. No extra samples or updates.

screen_gate.minecart: Every seed >=8/10 deliveries at BOTH task profiles; positive paired utility vs A at each profile for each seed. Preserve A baseline and all failures. Prefer passing simpler B/C; choose by minimum seed/profile success then mean paired utility, ties B before C before D; freeze selection before P3.
screen_gate.effect: Show each paired seed effect, factorial main/interaction contrasts and uncertainty; n=3 is feasibility, no superiority significance claim.

limitations: New controls use deliberately separated RNG streams; no exact old-training trajectory claim
Conditional Q and loss interventions may still fail
No adaptive benefit or dynamics generalization claim
No reference/scale/checkpoint/final-test tuning
plan.stop_rule: Exactly twelve new jobs; fixed final-only gate, no seed substitution, outcome extension or automatic retries. Technical resume requires explicit inspected state; no original-study restart.
plan.loss: Masked vector Huber at lambda=0; (1-lambda)*vector Huber + lambda*Huber(w-dot TD), lambda=.5 for C/D, common active-head normalization. Fixed prospective coefficients, not optimized defaults.
